name: NoteDiscovery
description: Light Markdown notes in plain files, with links, a graph and search

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your notes, as plain Markdown files in folders, and the login password and key (.icestore). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: NoteDiscovery web app and API, published on host as 6788

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: AUTHENTICATION_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password to open your notes. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.
